title.zh: 有限接合树从指定片段提升
title.en: Finite joining trees lift from specified fragments

statement.en: A description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of its frame, with no premise, and then every finite joining tree lifts with its own leaves; with excluded middle as a hypothesis, a code reading the branching tests exactly and reducedly lifts one with listed outcomes.
statement.zh: 一个描述提升一个接合，恰当具有同一编码是该接合之框的互模拟，不加前提；凡它提升之处，每个有限接合树以其自身的叶提升。以排中律为假设，精确且约化地读出分支检验的编码，提升每对都接合为列出片段的接合。

laws.en: A joining relates two fragments to what they join into; read through a description, codes join where fragments with those codes join into one with that code. The description lifts the joining, every joining of the codes of two fragments coming from a joining of those fragments, exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the joining's frame, whose moves join a partner on either side; no premise.
laws.zh: 接合把两个片段关联到它们接合所成者；经描述读出，凡有具这些编码的片段接合为具该编码者，诸编码即接合。描述提升接合（两片段之编码的每个接合都来自这两片段的接合），恰当具同一编码是接合之框的互模拟，框之动是在任一侧接合一个伙伴；不加前提。

laws.en: Where it lifts, a joining of codes is exactly the code of a joining of any fragments having them; a description identifying exactly the alike fragments of the joining's frame lifts it.
laws.zh: 凡它提升之处，编码之接合恰是具这些编码的任何片段之接合的编码；恰认同接合之框中相似片段的描述提升该接合。

laws.en: Where a description lifts a joining, every finite binary tree of joinings lifts: the tree with its leaves read through the description joins into a code exactly where the tree with its own leaves joins into a fragment with that code, the leaves staying the given fragments.
laws.zh: 凡描述提升一个接合，每个有限二叉接合树皆提升：叶经描述读出的树接合为一个编码，恰当以自身之叶的树接合为具该编码的片段；叶始终是所给的片段。

laws.en: Where having one code is passing the same branching tests, the description lifts the joining exactly where passing the same branching tests is a bisimulation of its frame.
laws.zh: 具同一编码即通过相同分支检验时，描述提升接合，恰当通过相同分支检验是其框的互模拟。

laws.en: With excluded middle as a hypothesis, where each pair of fragments joins into a listed set of fragments, a presentation reading the branching tests of the joining's frame exactly and giving fragments passing the same tests one code lifts the joining.
laws.zh: 以排中律为假设，凡每对片段都接合为一组列出的片段，精确读出接合之框的分支检验、并给通过相同检验之片段同一编码的呈现，提升该接合。

hypotheses.zh: lifts_iff 与 tree_lifts 不加前提。FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact 以排中律为具名假设（不是公理），每对接合为列出的片段（FiniteOutcomes），以及接合之框的分支检验（否定、合取、左右接合之动，无原子主张）的一个 Exact 且 Reduced 的呈现。
hypotheses.en: No premise for lifts_iff and tree_lifts. FiniteOutcomes.lifts_of_exact takes excluded middle as a named hypothesis (not an axiom), each pair joining into listed fragments (FiniteOutcomes), and a presentation of the branching tests of the joining's frame (negation, conjunction and the left and right joining moves, no atomic claims) that is Exact and Reduced.

does_not_show.en: The laws cover finite binary trees of joinings: no shared nodes, cycles or infinite completion.
does_not_show.zh: 规律只涉及有限二叉接合树：不涵盖共享节点、循环或无限完成。

does_not_show.en: Realizing a tree of joinings does not show that a resource can be copied, and says nothing of actual scheduling.
does_not_show.zh: 实现接合树并不表明资源可被复制，也不涉及实际调度。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated core checker: Becoming.Joining and Becoming.JoiningCodes are bound to receipts in becoming/becoming-checks, and every cited declaration has an empty axiom report, excluded middle entering only as a named hypothesis. The periphery's earlier form (deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningBranches, its receipt in deeper/explanatory-joining-branches-checks) is a provenance reference.
validation_scope.zh: 合并核心检查器实查：Becoming.Joining 与 Becoming.JoiningCodes 绑定 becoming/becoming-checks 中的回执，所引声明公理报告全空，排中律只作为具名假设出现。外围的早先形式（deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningBranches，其回执在 deeper/explanatory-joining-branches-checks）为来源引用。

next_delta.zh: 复用有限条件程序与真实余项恢复；继续建立内部语法不同的说明之间余项、判断与实际形成关系的有据翻译，区分语义可判定与实际取得。
next_delta.en: Reuse finite guarded programs and coherent residual recovery; establish warranted residual/guard/formation translation between descriptions with different internal syntax, distinguishing semantic tests from actual acquisition.

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 代表片段一致的输出提升接入复合结构。
detail.en: Representative-wise output lifting feeds the compound structure.

output.zh: 每个编码输出可由指定输入对实现。
output.en: Every code outcome is realizable by the specified input pair.

input.zh: tree_lifts 在每个内部节点消费接合之提升；叶子固定。
input.en: tree_lifts consumes the joining's lifting at every internal node, keeping leaves fixed.

conditions.zh: 同一 J、编码、有限纤维、Exact、Reduced 完整保留。
conditions.en: The same J, encoding, finite fibers, Exact and Reduced are retained.

detail.en: Retained-reference formation across different carriers is checked at its new scope; it does not rewrite this result’s proof scope.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。描述提升结合处，每一有限结合树以其自身之叶提升（Joining.tree_lifts）。外围的 tree_lifts 在脊柱上成立（Joining.tree_lifts_of_em），排中律作为具名假设 em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p，只用于在结果已列出时把通过相同分支检验认同为相同，即外围用经典推理之处；无此假设时，提升恰是同一编码为互模拟（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Where a description lifts the joining, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves (Joining.tree_lifts). The periphery's tree_lifts holds on the spine (Joining.tree_lifts_of_em): excluded middle is named as the hypothesis em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p and used only to identify passing the same branching tests with likeness where outcomes are listed, which is where the periphery reasoned classically; without it, lifting is exactly having one code being a bisimulation (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item DF (study section 418): statement added and the claim restated on the core laws: a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of its frame, with no premise, and every finite tree then lifts; with excluded middle as a named hypothesis, an exact reduced presentation of the branching tests lifts a joining with listed outcomes. The premises restated accordingly (they named the periphery target of finite negation, conjunction and joining-successor questions; earlier: One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set. | The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates. | Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.). Aliases now the core names; the earlier ones Generative.ExplanatoryJoiningBranches.tree_lifts (retired module) and Becoming.Joining.tree_lifts_of_em (retired module) are recorded here (their declarations stay in the provenance references); the retired operation_lifts no longer named in the dependency interface.
